epics.name: Sign-in and App Shell
epics.goal: Everyone signs in with email and password, lands on the right page for their role, sees only the menu items their role allows, and gets a clear on-page message if they open a page they can't use.

epics.name: Contact Form and My Messages
epics.goal: A Visitor sends an enquiry, sees a 'Message sent!' confirmation of what they sent, and can look back over their own messages (and only theirs).

epics.name: Inbox
epics.goal: Support Agents and Admins see every enquiry in one sortable, paged table and can narrow it down by category, status or text.

epics.name: Working an Enquiry
epics.goal: Support Agents and Admins open an enquiry, mark it In Progress, and resolve it with a Reply Note; Admins can also delete spam after confirming.
